subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four exact-pin assertions are synchronized, should this grouped action refresh be accepted for secret-, release-, scan-, Docker-, repository-management-, and agent-capable workflows?
rationale: The mechanical defects have a clear repair, but the protected security label and broad executable dependency scope require a human supply-chain acceptance decision.

options.title: Accept after guard repair
options.body: Update the four assertions, refresh the branch, and require green exact-head workflow checks before merging the verified upstream releases.

options.title: Split sensitive upgrades
options.body: Separate token, release, CodeQL, Docker, repository-management, and Codex action bumps into smaller independently reviewed PRs.

options.title: Pause grouped update
options.body: Retain the existing pins until maintainers are ready to accept the combined executable-dependency scope.

recommendation.title: Accept after guard repair
recommendation.body: Update the four assertions, refresh the branch, and require green exact-head workflow checks before merging the verified upstream releases.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available repository-owner route for accepting protected, security-sensitive workflow dependency changes across multiple automation domains.
